narrative:
The raids begin before the court agrees on their name. Shipwright Torvald Enge can reinforce the harbor chain, but only if guild coin, crown soldiers, and local boats cooperate. Every faction has a reason to distrust the others.

@Torvald: A hull does not care whose banner paid for its nails. It either floats or it does not.

narrative:
Two villages burn on opposite sides of the bay. Maren's people can fully defend only one before the invaders land in force. She does not dress the arithmetic up as courage.

@Maren: Tell me which name I carry home. I will carry the other one myself.

narrative: The harbor chain holds. The strange fleet withdraws beyond the fog, leaving wreckage but no beachhead. Torvald counts timbers; Maren counts people. Both numbers are smaller than they should be.

choices.label: Watch the coast begin to rebuild

effects.run_history: Helped repel the Salt Sea invasion

narrative: The invaders keep a strip of coast and abandon the rest. It is not peace; it is a map with a fresh wound on it. Reyva's ships hold position offshore, neither advancing nor leaving.

effects.run_history: Saw the Salt Sea invasion leave the coast partially occupied

narrative:
The beachhead becomes a port by nightfall. Regent-Marshal Halvern Cotte burns his contingency orders one page at a time so they cannot become prizes. The last page burns in his hand.

@Halvern: Institutions are people remembering what they promised each other. Tell them that, if anyone is left to listen.

effects.run_history: Saw the Salt Sea invasion overwhelm the coast and claim Halvern Cotte

narrative: The coast is scarred, but the realm still has names for its losses. Then wells turn black inland, livestock refuse their feed, and a cold wind blows from no coast at all. Something has noticed how thin the realm has become.

narrativeVariants.flags.foreign_invasion_outcome == 'repel: The coast begins to rebuild. Even so, wells turn black inland, livestock refuse their feed, and a cold wind blows from no coast at all. Something has noticed the realm's wounds.

effects.run_history: Followed the inland omens after the Salt Sea invasion
